summary: Final acceptance fails at 635e9308 for three record reasons. The delivered work passes. All three gate sweeps print NEWFAIL=0 against the track baseline, and every spec criterion has evidence. The later commits are not covered, plan.md fails the closeout marker check, and the committed exports.md is stale. One Major finding needs a decision: the structured helper has no request timeout.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] final-acceptance: The later commits 987a919e and 635e9308 are not covered. git diff --name-only 8b66cbf4 HEAD lists measure/tech-debt.md and metadata.json of the track. Both are track paths, and neither is a plan or evidence file. The latest phase acceptance audited 8b66cbf4, not HEAD. The diff holds no production, test, or script file. Fix: run a phase acceptance on the HEAD that follows F2 and F3, then run final acceptance again.

F2 [Blocker] final-acceptance: plan.md fails the closeout marker check. plan_closeout_feedback reports 208 items on the plan at HEAD: 197 nested legacy [ ] sub-boxes (193 under [x] tasks and 4 under the deferred live smoke test), and 11 [x] lines with no commit SHA on the line. The top-level count is 0, so the role gate does not see them. The archived vinext-oxc-toolchain_20261114 plan gives 0 items. Fix: a build session sets each of the 193 boxes to [x] where the parent task holds SHA evidence, marks the 4 smoke-test boxes [b] (deferred:daniel), and adds a SHA to each of the 11 lines. The S3 Verify task holds no SHA in its body.

F3 [Blocker] final-acceptance: The committed measure/generated/exports.md at HEAD is stale. It lists 4 entry points of ai-tutoring and lacks ./structured, which the manifest at HEAD lists. Only the uncommitted working-tree copy is fresh. bash measure/doctor.sh exits 0 only because of that file, and the doctor compares file bytes. A clean checkout of HEAD reports exports.md as stale. Fix: commit the regenerated exports.md. Do not commit the machine-specific routes.md change.
nonblocking_findings: F4 [Major] final-acceptance: The structured-output helper has no request timeout. The previous code had 15000 ms: the package provider at 55e7952b providers.ts:326 and the deleted OpenAI teacher provider at 8283f9fa providers.ts:25. structured.ts:151-155 builds the SDK client with no timeoutMs. structured.ts:195-217 sends no timeout, and the SDK has no default (sdks.js:150-182). The probe shows the chat path rejects within 20 s on a server that never answers, and the structured path is still pending. Both callers await the helper: submit/route.ts:239 and ai-error-summary/route.ts:127. The deterministic fallback never runs on a stalled call. The R-A1 test (structured.test.ts:244-253) builds its own client with timeoutMs 15000, so it hides the gap. No spec criterion names a helper timeout, so the finding is not blocking. Fix before PR3: reuse the AbortController timeout of providers.ts:197-209 and add a Red test.

F5 [Nit] final-acceptance: evidence.md:97-101 still misdescribes the bundle growth. It says the delta comes from hashed chunk names. The delta is one SDK chunk of about 0.84 MB raw in each app (S1 acceptance F3, never fixed). The BM2 total grew from 9104.97 KB to 10035.04 KB (+10.2%) against a 3000 KB budget that baseline already exceeded. gates.sh cannot see a new or larger [EXCEEDS] entry (S1 acceptance F2). Neither item is in tech-debt.md.

F6 [Nit] final-acceptance: The S1 manual verification stays [b] (deferred:closeout-steward, plan.md:175-176) while S2, S3, and S4 are marked PM-verified. The brief names the live smoke test as the only open item. The PM or the closeout steward must close the S1 item with the S1 checkpoint SHA 14f75797.

F7 [Nit] final-acceptance: Process records are incomplete. metadata.json has no escalation key although the PM approved more than two remediation rounds (S1 r3 to r5, S2 r2 to r4, S3 r3 to r5b). The approvals live in deviation_notes only. plan.md pins test counts and has no 'Late finding' lines. Three code or test commits have no git note: d8e08cde, 1833c526, and e46ee525.

F8 [Nit] final-acceptance: Closeout inputs need a decision. measure/gates.json:4-6 names measure/tracks/openrouter-sdk-ai-layer_20261114/gates.sh with label green, so the paths break after the archive move (A9 for support files). The file has no GENERATED_CHECK_COMMAND, which the closeout check requires. The vinext-oxc closeout set it to npm run generate.

F9 [Nit] final-acceptance: The structured path ignores the PII flag (S3 acceptance F4, carried). structured.ts:168-172 inlines require_parameters and never reads sendsPii. No current role sets the flag, so no request is wrong today. A future flagged structured role would send PII without zdr. The plan records it. tech-debt.md does not.

It fails at the track base dbf4d65e too, and no track commit changed AGENTS.md. This is framework drift outside the track. Route it to the orchestrator audit.

ratings.evidence: Every spec criterion has evidence at HEAD (165 of 165 package tests, 14 targeted jobs, NEWFAIL=0 in 3 sweeps), but the structured helper lost the 15000 ms timeout (structured.ts:151-217).

The no-PII tests run the real routes with fixture identities (submit.no-pii.test.ts:128-141) and the wire test checks the serialized body (structured.test.ts:241-294), but no test covers the structured timeout and the R-A1 test builds its own client with timeoutMs 15000.

The 113 track commits change the planned product files and the documented extras (one lint-disable allowlist entry, the server-composition test, condensed tech-debt rows), and package.json changes stay in ai-tutoring.
The records cite logs and valid SHAs (48 of 48 resolve), but 11 [x] lines hold no SHA, evidence.md:97-101 misstates the bundle growth, and the doctor-exit-0 claim holds only with an uncommitted file.

reviewer_ratings.evidence: Its S4 verdict on removals and docs holds and F1 reproduces at ai-error-summary.test.ts:34,42-43, but it passed 3bcf2b31 while openrouter-only.test.ts held the NUL skip that acceptance r1 called a blocker.

Its no-secret and no-other-provider claims reproduce (0 grep matches), but its summary says the S1 and S3 layer already replaces the removed timeout controls, which is false for structured.ts (probe: still pending at 20 s).
Its claim that runtime routes and role docs are unchanged holds: spec.md:146-151 equals tech-stack.md:83-88 and the G-TEACHER-ROUTE job passes 12 cases.
Its S4 attacks hold, but its ADV-S4-1 scan carried the NUL skip until a330414e, and no S3 or S4 adversarial result file mentions a structured-helper timeout (grep of the result files).
